# 01 · Regaining Control

*Observability for OpenStack Platforms in Difficulty*

**Ten signals, one shared language. A visual guide for technical decision-makers.**

![Regaining Control — Observability for OpenStack Platforms in Difficulty: the ten signals converging into understanding, then decision, and the seven-step path](../figures/01-regaining-control.png)

### What this guide is

17 pages, one idea and one figure per page, 10 minutes to read the essentials, 30 to go deeper. It is written for the people who decide what happens to a platform, not for the people who operate it, and it stays technically exact so that both can read it together.

### The path

`Observe → Understand → Correlate → Prioritise → Stabilise → Regain control → Decide`

### The message

> Observability is a shared language for understanding operational reality.
>
> When a platform becomes difficult to operate, the first step is not to change it. It is to understand it.

**Soufian Zaouam** — Platform engineer, Day-2 operations of mission-critical OpenStack platforms; author of "OpenStack, the Day After Tomorrow". [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/soufian-zaouam) · [GitHub](https://github.com/soufian-zaouam)
